meta.name: bulk-rnaseq
meta.description: End-to-end bulk RNA-seq orchestrator — takes raw FASTQ reads through QC and trimming (FastQC, fastp/Trim Galore), alignment and quantification (STAR, Salmon, featureCounts), assembles a gene-level counts matrix, then hands off to differential expression (pydeseq2), pathway/GSEA enrichment (pathway-enrichment), and publication figures (scientific-visualization). Use whenever the user has bulk RNA-seq reads or quant output and wants a complete, reproducible differential-expression workflow — e.g. "analyze my RNA-seq", "FASTQ to DESeq2", "run nf-core/rnaseq", "STAR/Salmon quantification", "build a counts matrix for DESeq2", or "go from reads to differentially expressed genes and enriched pathways". Routes between an nf-core/rnaseq (Nextflow) path and a standalone STAR/Salmon path, and covers experimental design, strandedness, and QC gates. For single-cell RNA-seq use the scanpy skill instead.

copy.tagline: 从原始测序数据到差异表达基因和通路富集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理批量RNA-seq数据，需要全自动分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Transform raw FASTQ reads into differentially expressed genes and enriched pathways
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with bulk RNA-seq data and need an end-to-end reproducible workflow

howto.what: 装上后，助手能按完整流程处理 bulk RNA-seq 数据：先从原始读数做质检与修剪，再用 STAR 或 Salmon 进行比对定量，生成基因计数矩阵，随后转交差异表达、通路富集和出图；它会在 nf-core 与独立工具两条路径中选择，并检查实验设计、链特异性和 QC。
howto.when: 当用户需要从 FASTQ 或定量结果做差异表达分析、运行 nf-core/rnaseq，或构建 DESeq2 计数矩阵时触发；单细胞数据不触发。

say.text: 帮我从原始 FASTQ 开始跑一遍 bulk RNA-seq 差异表达流程。
say.note: 助手会先检查实验设计，再依次执行质检、比对、定量与差异表达。

say.text: 用 nf-core/rnaseq 分析我的样本，锁版本 3.26.0 跑完。
say.note: 助手会验证样本表并运行 Nextflow 流程。

say.text: 我有 Salmon 定量结果，帮我生成计数矩阵并做 DESeq2。

howto.what_en: Claude can run bulk RNA-seq end-to-end: FASTQ QC/trimming, STAR/Salmon quantification, gene counts matrix, then DE, enrichment, and figures. It routes between nf-core and standalone paths, and checks design, strandedness, and QC.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs differential expression from FASTQ or quant results, wants to run nf-core/rnaseq, or build a DESeq2 counts matrix. Single-cell data should use scanpy instead.

say_en.text: Run a bulk RNA-seq differential expression workflow from my raw FASTQ files.
say_en.note: Claude checks design first, then runs QC, alignment, quantification, and DE.

say_en.text: Run nf-core/rnaseq on my samples, pinning pipeline version 3.26.0.
say_en.note: Claude validates the samplesheet and runs the Nextflow pipeline.

say_en.text: I have Salmon quant output; build a counts matrix and run DESeq2.
say_en.note: Claude uses build_counts_matrix.py to convert the matrix.
